params.name: methodsArray
params.description: Filled with the names of methods authorized for use in formulas -- confirmed an array (not a scalar Text) by the doc syntax line 'methodsArray : Text array'.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns, in methodsArray, the names (or '@' wildcard groups) of methods currently authorized for use in formulas via SET ALLOWED METHODS.

constraints: Returns exactly what was previously passed to SET ALLOWED METHODS, including any '@' wildcard group strings (not the individually expanded method names); returns an empty array if SET ALLOWED METHODS has never been called.
